title: Upholstered Panel — one Math Engine, channelled pad field, float gap and halo LED
description:
A parametric UPHOLSTERED PANEL on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A SEGMENT. This is the plan's hero wall: a floor-to-cove channelled panel that floats off the wall with an LED halo behind it. It is deliberately NOT part of the bed — `bed-with-math.headboardHeight` is a board bolted to a bed, and a 2.74 × 2.97 m wall feature is a different thing that must survive the bed being moved.

ALL FOUR PATTERNS ARE ONE BROADCAST. The pad field is a grid of `_nu` columns by `_nz` rows, and the pattern only decides whether each count is a division or a 1 — vertical is `_nz = 1`, horizontal is `_nu = 1`, square grid is both, plain is both with the groove set to zero. There is no second body for any of them, which is why changing pattern cannot change anything else about the panel.

THE GROOVE IS NOT DRAWN. A groove is the gap the pads leave, subtracted half from each side of every pad so the field still fills the frame exactly whatever the count. Drawing the groove as a solid would double-count the same millimetres.

THE FLOAT GAP IS WHAT MAKES THE HALO POSSIBLE. `_fg` pushes the backer off the wall face, and the halo frame lives in that gap and nowhere else — set the gap to zero and the halo drops out on its own rather than being clipped into the wall.

THE LIP SHRINKS THE PAD FIELD, it does not overlay it: `_fu0 = _u0 + _lw`. Turn the lip off and the pads take the full face, so the two can never overlap.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS: 2.743 × 2.972 m at 0.133 m total depth, 0.064 m off the wall, 27 vertical channels at 0.101 m pitch, 8.15 m² of face and 11.2 m of halo.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. Pads are flat-fronted quads — there is no crowned or buttoned cushion, and a diamond or chevron pattern is not a grid so it is not here. The lip is square, on two sides and the top only.

props.name: Material
props.value: ivory bouclé upholstery, light oak veneer lip, matte

props.name: Semantics
props.value: upholstered headboard wall, soft vertical channels, warm halo glow, calm hotel bedroom

params.name: Upholstered Panel maths
params.expr:
_natL = length
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_Ln = length * _s
_Ht = height * _s
_z0 = baseOffset
_z1 = _z0 + _Ht
_pad = paddingDepth * _s
_bk = backerThk * _s
_fg = floatGap * _s
_Dtot = _fg + _bk + _pad
_bodyL = _Ln
_bodyW = _Dtot
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
_u0 = 0 - _Ln / 2
_u1 = _Ln / 2
# v1 is the WALL side. The panel stands off it by the float gap, which is what makes the halo
# possible: the LED lives in that gap and there is nowhere else for it to be.
_v1 = _Dtot / 2
_v0 = 0 - _Dtot / 2
_wall = _v1
_bkV1 = _wall - _fg
_bkV0 = _bkV1 - _bk
_padV0 = _v0
_BACK = hcat(_u0, _bkV0, _u1, _bkV0, _u1, _bkV1, _u0, _bkV1, _z0, _z1, 1)
# Edge lip — a frame on two sides and the top, standing in the same plane as the pads.
_lip = trimLip > 0
_tw = min(trimWidth * _s, min(_Ln, _Ht) / 6)
_lw = _lip ? _tw : 0
_LP1 = hcat(_u0, _padV0, _u0 + _tw, _padV0, _u0 + _tw, _bkV0, _u0, _bkV0, _z0, _z1, 3)
_LP2 = hcat(_u1 - _tw, _padV0, _u1, _padV0, _u1, _bkV0, _u1 - _tw, _bkV0, _z0, _z1, 3)
_LP3 = hcat(_u0 + _tw, _padV0, _u1 - _tw, _padV0, _u1 - _tw, _bkV0, _u0 + _tw, _bkV0, _z1 - _tw, _z1, 3)
_LIP = _lip ? vcat(_LP1, _LP2, _LP3) : zeros(0, 11)
# The pad field. All four patterns are ONE broadcast: a grid of _nu columns by _nz rows, where
# the pattern only decides whether each count is a division or a 1. Vertical is nz = 1,
# horizontal is nu = 1, grid is both, plain is both 1 with no groove.
_isV = pattern == 'Vertical channels'
_isH = pattern == 'Horizontal channels'
_isG = pattern == 'Square grid'
_isP = pattern == 'Plain'
_fu0 = _u0 + _lw
_fu1 = _u1 - _lw
_fz0 = _z0
_fz1 = _z1 - _lw
_fL = max(0.05, _fu1 - _fu0)
_fH = max(0.05, _fz1 - _fz0)
_pitch = max(0.01, channelPitch * _s)
_nu = (_isV || _isG) ? max(1, round(_fL / _pitch)) : 1
_nz = (_isH || _isG) ? max(1, round(_fH / _pitch)) : 1
_gw = _isP ? 0 : min(grooveWidth * _s, _pitch / 2)
_pu = _fL / _nu
_pv = _fH / _nz
_N = _nu * _nz
_iu = kron(arange(_nu), ones(_nz, 1))
_iz = kron(ones(_nu, 1), arange(_nz))
_pa0 = _fu0 + _iu * _pu + _gw / 2
_pa1 = _pa0 + _pu - _gw
_pb0 = _fz0 + _iz * _pv + _gw / 2
_pb1 = _pb0 + _pv - _gw
_PADS = hcat(_pa0, fill(_N,1,_padV0), _pa1, fill(_N,1,_padV0), _pa1, fill(_N,1,_bkV0), _pa0, fill(_N,1,_bkV0), _pb0, _pb1, fill(_N,1,2))
# Halo — a thin frame in the float gap, inset from the panel edge so it throws onto the wall.
_hi = min(ledInset * _s, min(_Ln, _Ht) / 4)
_hw = 0.014
_haloV0 = _bkV1
_haloV1 = min(_wall, _bkV1 + max(0.006, _fg * 0.6))
_H1 = hcat(_u0 + _hi, _haloV0, _u0 + _hi + _hw, _haloV0, _u0 + _hi + _hw, _haloV1, _u0 + _hi, _haloV1, _z0 + _hi, _z1 - _hi, 4)
_H2 = hcat(_u1 - _hi - _hw, _haloV0, _u1 - _hi, _haloV0, _u1 - _hi, _haloV1, _u1 - _hi - _hw, _haloV1, _z0 + _hi, _z1 - _hi, 4)
_H3 = hcat(_u0 + _hi + _hw, _haloV0, _u1 - _hi - _hw, _haloV0, _u1 - _hi - _hw, _haloV1, _u0 + _hi + _hw, _haloV1, _z1 - _hi - _hw, _z1 - _hi, 4)
_H4 = hcat(_u0 + _hi + _hw, _haloV0, _u1 - _hi - _hw, _haloV0, _u1 - _hi - _hw, _haloV1, _u0 + _hi + _hw, _haloV1, _z0 + _hi, _z0 + _hi + _hw, 4)
_HALO = (haloLed > 0 && _fg > 0.005) ? vcat(_H1, _H2, _H3, _H4) : zeros(0, 11)
Q = vcat(_BACK, _PADS, _LIP, _HALO)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Backer3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Pads3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Lip3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 3)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Halo3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 4)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
BackerPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
PadsPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 2)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
LipPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 3)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
HaloPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 4)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Metrics
panelLength = _Ln
panelHeight = _Ht
topHeight = _z1
totalDepth = _Dtot
standoff = _fg
padCount = _N
padPitchU = _pu
padPitchZ = _pv
faceArea = _Ln * _Ht
upholsteredArea = _N * (_pu - _gw) * (_pv - _gw)
haloRun = (haloLed > 0 && _fg > 0.005) ? (2 * (_Ln - 2 * _hi) + 2 * (_Ht - 2 * _hi)) : 0
